corpus: Rounds 9 and 10 — dead nodes and labels that are not circuits (2026-04-11)
why: These are the findings a name-based check cannot make: a net that exists, is spelled the same on both sides, and has nowhere for current to go. netlist.py's D1 and D2 classes already report the surviving instances, so this file is where Phase 0 gets to be measured rather than trusted.

entries.title: R19 and C20 attached to a dead net, disconnected from MENU_K
entries.must_report: R16 pin 1 is on a net with no other pin, so it carries no current and its value has no effect on any node voltage
entries.note: R19/C20 were deleted from the design after this finding, so the historical part cannot be re-detached. The mutation reproduces the same electrical shape on R16, which is the surviving resistor of that network.

entries.title: I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCK allocated as nets but never used
entries.must_report: a net named I2S_BCLK with exactly one pin (U1.8) and zero copper — a label, not a circuit
entries.note: FIXED 2026-07-26: the reservation nets were retired outright — NET_LIST ids 24/25 gap-retired like 18/19, U1 pads 8/9 netless, schematic labels fall back to plain GPIO15/GPIO16 (T1_ALLOW, same class as the PSRAM trio), and THREE gate allowlists died with them (verify_design_intent KNOWN_SINGLE + DIRECT_ROUTED, drc_check _UNROUTED_OK). The generated test firmware also stopped driving .clk on GPIO15, matching production audio.c. The mutation re-creates the one-pin net so the bench must rediscover the original shape.

entries.title: the strapping-pin gate's RC maths assumes an external R3 that is not fitted
entries.must_report: the EN node has no resistor and no capacitor on it, so no RC time constant exists to compute; any boot-delay figure derived from R3 = 10k and C3 = 100nF describes a network the board does not have
entries.note: FIXED in the gates on 2026-07-26, live as a board fact. simulate_circuit.py no longer computes a delay from R3/C3 — it reads the EN net from the copper, finds no R and no C, and passes only while docs/known-issues.md records the absence (same pattern as verify_strapping_pins). The board still lacks the RC, which is what this entry detects.

entries.title: phantom nets LCD_RD / LCD_BL — declared in both files, zero pads in either
entries.must_report: a net declared in the board's net table that no pad carries; it is not a connection, it is a name, and no existing check can see it — T1/T2 compare names, which matched because both files declared it, and T4 iterates schematic pins, of which it had none
entries.note: Fixed on main and in this branch independently and identically on 2026-07-26 — net ids 18/19 retired with a documented gap, the DS1 stubs relabelled +3V3, and datasheet_specs J4 pads 8/29 tightened from _any_of to _exact. Kept as a corpus entry because netlist.py's D1 class is what found it, and a detector that has nothing to rediscover is a detector nobody can measure.
